name: Érsekhalma (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Érsekhalma (a light blue shield with a kneeling figure, red mantling and a scroll) above the name 1986 ÉRSEKHALMA in red.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
